emma-support: Hey team — customer reported a weird embeddings issue after upgrading the TS SDK to 1.4.2. Their embedding vectors appear to sometimes come back with the wrong dimension (expected 1536, some responses are 768). They see a flurry of retries/timeouts around the same time. Root cause or quick mitigation?

rachel-customer: Repro steps from their app: they batch 24 sentences, call the embeddings endpoint via ts-sdk, sometimes get a 502 then a retry. After retry they get a payload where the first N vectors are 1536 but the last 1-2 are 768-length. Paste of minimal logs: 
```
Request payload: batch_size=24, model=redwood-embed-1536
Response 502 -> SDK retry
Second response 200, vectors len: [1536,1536,1536,768,768]
HTTP headers: x-retries:1, x-request-id: rcst-54321
SDK: ts-sdk@1.4.2
```
They say downgrading to 1.4.1 stops the issue.

sam-engineering: Thanks — this looks like a buffering/serialization bug in the TS client when a retry triggers a partial flush. Hypothesis: when the retry code path re-sends the request, the buffered binary blob for vectors is truncated for the tail of the batch, producing shorter vector output that the server then decodes as a smaller-dim embedding. I can repro locally with a synthetic workload that forces a 502 mid-flight.

alex-devex: Workaround for customers: pin ts-sdk to 1.4.1 or set env `REDWOOD_EMBED_BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS=2000` to increase flush timeout so retry race is less likely. Also we should expose `batch_flush_on_retry=false` as a temporary toggle.

priya-ml: Important: embeddings API requires fixed-dimension outputs. Server-side we should reject inconsistent dims, not try to pad. Padding would mask data corruption. Do we have request ids from the customer? If we can match request lifecycle we can tell whether the server returned mixed dims or the client post-processed incorrectly.

rachel-customer: Request IDs: rcst-54321, rcst-54322. Attached small curl repro they used (they said it fails ~1/20 runs): 
```
# pseudo curl that uses the ts-sdk behind the scenes
node repro.js --batch 24 --model redwood-embed-1536 --sleep 30ms
// repro.js simulates intermittent 502 from an HTTP proxy
```
They also tried python-sdk 0.9.3 and did NOT see the issue.

sam-engineering: Added notes from local repro: when injecting a 502 at socket close time, the client retry logic calls `sendBatch()` but the internal `Uint8Array` pointer for the last vector length is off-by-N bytes due to a previous `slice()` call. PR #4721 fixes pointer handling and adds a unit test that simulates partial writes + retries. I'll open the fix and patch release.

infra-bot: Alert: rate-limit events for customer id cust-998 during window 2026-02-22T15:04:xxZ - 120 429s (avg RPS spike).

alex-devex: Ops mitigation steps to propose to customer: 
- Temporarily pin TS SDK to 1.4.1
- Increase `REDWOOD_EMBED_BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS` to 2s (or set `REDWOOD_EMBED_BATCH_SIZE=12`)
- If using custom proxy, add keepalive + avoid injecting artificial 502s

sam-engineering: Triage plan: 
1) Roll a hotfix release ts-sdk@1.4.3 with PR #4721 (fix pointer + retries).
2) Add integration test that fuzzes mid-request disconnects and asserts no dim mismatch.
3) Add server-side guard that logs and rejects responses with mixed dims, including original request id.
4) Reach out to customer for full HTTP capture (they already shared rcst-54321/22).

priya-ml: Also add a monitoring alert for "embedding-dim-variance" so we catch this proactively.

rachel-customer: Thanks — applying the pin now and will test. If you push 1.4.3 let me know and we'll validate at scale. Really appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

sam-engineering: Pushed a draft 1.4.3 candidate to npm with the fix (tag: rc-hotfix). Would like beta testers. If anyone from support can escalate to the customer, ask them to try `npm i ts-sdk@npm:ts-sdk@1.4.3-rc1` and repro.

emma-support: Assigning follow-ups: sam (fix + release), alex (customer comms + mitigations), priya (monitoring rule), rachel (customer validation). Updating ticket; will mark as P0 until we confirm fix in customer environment.

rachel-customer: Verified quick smoke: after pinning to 1.4.1 the dim mismatch stopped in 200 runs. Will try rc1 later today.

sam-engineering: Note for release notes: root cause: off-bytes in client buffer during retry leading to partial vector serialization -> server returned smaller-length vector which violated embedding dim contract. Remediation: client patch + monitoring + guard on server to reject inconsistent dims.

infra-bot: Deploy status: ts-sdk@1.4.3-rc1 published to npm. CI: green on unit/integration smoke.

alex-devex: I'll drop a short snippet for docs/known-issues + mitigation in the SDK breaking-changes doc and link to ticket.

emma-support: Great work team. Keep this thread updated with customer validation and release stable tag.
